Hey, doing well, thanks!

`updateMany` sets the **same** `data` on every matched row, so it can't assign two different `order` values in one call (crud.mdx, "Update multiple records"). For swapping two different values atomically, use `$transaction([])` with two separate `update` calls instead:

```ts
await prisma.$transaction([
  prisma.todoGroup.update({ where: { id: groupA.id }, data: { order: 2 } }),
  prisma.todoGroup.update({ where: { id: groupB.id }, data: { order: 1 } }),
]);
```

Source: `apps/docs/content/docs/orm/v7/prisma-client/queries/transactions.mdx`, section "Using `$transaction([])` for independent writes" (line 326) — since these are two independent writes, not dependent on each other's generated IDs, this is the right pattern rather than `updateMany`.
